ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar May-18-2004 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name and Gender.
Commissioner Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Yvonne Lee.
Allison Austin, Esq., for Petitioner: Diana Louise White, also present, was sworn and examined.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for change of name to: Nick Robertson.
The Court further orders the GENDER of Nick Robertson is changed from FEMALE to MALE.
Decree signed in open court.
